evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: Distinct requirement specifying content identification/fingerprinting method; not substantially contained in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: Uses profile-based personalization which differs in context/method from other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative or social-search approach; different goal/method than other music discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Specifies similarity to a given music video (content-similarity) — distinct context from other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path.
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-driven discovery is a different business rule/approach than other music search stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Concerns uploading and tag availability for processing — different system obligation than search/discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: UI/visualization requirement specific to thumbnails; not substantially duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: General similarity information requirement; distinct from story that specifies perceptual similarity (ZO-009) because similarity definition is a business rule.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Specifies 'perceptually similar' (a particular similarity metric/business rule), which differentiates it from general similarity requests.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from explicit search stories and other recommendation items.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: News- and location-driven recommendation is a distinct trigger/source for recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Entity-recognition for persons is a distinct detection requirement compared to other entity types.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a different entity-detection requirement than persons/brands/logos.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection (broadcaster logos) is a specific entity type distinct from other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification differs in target entity from other detection stories; not duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation flow is a distinct interaction and trigger compared to other discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest.
evaluations.rationale: Geospatial map-based content discovery is a unique context not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-driven search is a specific search technique distinct from other search criteria.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin validation/editing of segmentation is a specific administrative capability not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is a distinct admin task and outcome.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based filtering/ranking is a distinct business rule not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: Tampering/edited-audio detection is a unique validation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content-safety rule distinct from other prefilter tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Low-level (asset) information prefiltering is a different business rule than high-level prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is a unique legal/compliance requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user.
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag based prefiltering is explicitly different from low-level prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: Aesthetic/interest assessment combining multiple signals is a particular analysis requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting when to prompt a scientist (actor & outcome) is different from general interest assessment or comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer profiling is a distinct requirement separate from content analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification for Galaxy Zoo is distinct by context and feature set.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project- and outcome-specific detection for empty/blank frames is distinct from other projects.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: A specific image-series detection task for timestamp malfunction is unique in goal and context.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Snapshot Serengeti is project-specific and different from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (e.g., behaviors/attributes) is a distinct output from species/number detection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct analytical requirement from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization for plankton is a specific vision task for Plankton Portal; unique from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific 'empty' detection for Plankton Portal differs from Snapshot Serengeti's empty detection (ZO-031).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation measurement is a distinct detection metric for plankton, not a duplicate of segmentation or species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Plankton Portal is project-specific and different from other projects' preclassification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis and video duration reduction is a project-specific processing need distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a unique detection requirement specific to the project and outcome.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite imagery is a distinct domain and goal.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer weighting based on experience is a specific scoring/aggregation rule unique from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is a specific image-cleaning requirement distinct from other prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct detection task not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a specific signal-processing requirement distinct from audio editing detection (ZO-022).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping whale calls is a specific audio-analytic task different from counting or denoising.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct analytical requirement from grouping calls or denoising.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Timing of interruption is a different concern than content/medium of interruption or education decisions (ZO-050 to ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Specifies medium for interruption (business rule) distinct from merely knowing when to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Timing to educate is a distinct decision from interruption timing and content/medium selection.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: Specifies medium for education; complementary but materially different from 'when' to educate (ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Determining which education content to give is a distinct selection requirement (which content) from timing or medium.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a specific event detection task distinct from prompting scientists or assessing image interest.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Decision rule for when an automated agent should comment is a unique automation/control requirement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: Specifies explanation timing for Zoonibot—a different action/outcome than commenting in general.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Specifying message content for Zoonibot is a distinct requirement (content) from timing/trigger rules.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Generic grouping by similarity is a different requirement from domain-specific grouping and other similarity tasks.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer history is a distinct recommendation goal from content recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a unique administrative feature not duplicated elsewhere.
